text:
marta: heads up — pushing canary to gcr://eu-west1/redwood/runtime:v2024-06-01-1122 is failing with repeated 429s from the registry. deploybot shows PutManifest errors and a couple 503s.

ops-dan: seeing the same in deploybot logs. looks like a short-lived quota burst. also noticed a mirror job `mirror-eu-to-us-20240601` started around the same time.

ci-bot: automated: job `mirror-eu-to-us-20240601` started at 2024-06-01T09:12:01Z, images: redwood/runtime:v2024-06-01-1122. requeue_count=2.

marta: can we avoid an immediate rollback? we have a 10:00-12:00 UTC change window and the canary is just 3% traffic. if we hold and re-tag/escrow we can preserve the release note flow.

release-manager-lee: prefer not to rollback unless telemetry shows regression. keep me posted — we need the final digest for the changelog.

ops-dan: plan suggestion: cancel mirror, create an escrow tag `v2024-06-01-1122-escrow` in GCR by copying the manifest, and switch deploybot publish concurrency to 1 with interval=45s for eu-west1. that should smooth the PutManifest rate.

security-ollie: quick reminder: if we copy manifest we need to attach cosign attestation again (timestamp must be within KMS policy window). otherwise provenance checks on mirrors will fail and requeue.

ci-bot: cancel request issued: `ci cancel mirror-eu-to-us-20240601` -> acknowledged 2024-06-01T09:15:12Z.

deploybot: automated: update applied to job `canary-eu-v2024-06-01-1122` - publish_strategy=staggered, concurrency=1, interval=45s, backoff=enabled.

ops-dan: how I copied manifest to escrow (commands):
```
# fetch manifest
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/runtime:v2024-06-01-1122 --format='get(image_manifest)' > manifest.json
# push as new tag pointing to same manifest
gcloud container images add-tag --quiet --source-manifest manifest.json gcr.io/redwood/runtime:v2024-06-01-1122-escrow
```
manifest push succeeded, digest unchanged (sha256:1234abcd5678ef90).

security-ollie: re-signed attestation with cosign and customer KMS. command: `cosign sign --kms projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:1234abcd...` then uploaded statement.

marta: after staggering started at ~09:18 we saw pushes succeed every ~50s, no more 429s. canary telemetry (p50/p95 latency, error rate) steady at baseline.

release-manager-lee: hold writing release notes until canary is green for 15m. if any regression, fallback target will be `sha256:fedcba9876`. also add a short note about mirror jobs during change windows.

ops-dan: one more operational tweak: adding a runbook step to set mirror job to rate-limited mode during official change windows to avoid competing pushes. i'll open a small PR to the CI job config.

ci-bot: note: previous mirror job failures due to missing attestation TTL recorded as INC-20240601-4.

deploybot: automated: job `canary-eu-v2024-06-01-1122` completed (status=SUCCESS) at 2024-06-01T09:33:54Z. promoted tags: `v2024-06-01-1122-escrow` -> `staging` (awaiting manual promote to prod-canary).

release-manager-lee: I'll manually promote to `prod-canary` in 5m and then publish release notes with digest sha256:1234abcd5678ef90 and changelog snippet.

marta: thanks all. closing unless someone objects. good catch on the attestation TTL — saved us a lot of churn.
